description: The file defines an abstract class 'AbstractRule' for validation rules within the OrangeHRM project. It extends a third-party validation rule class and overrides the 'reportError' method to throw a custom ValidationException.

classes.name: AbstractRule
classes.description: An abstract class for validation rules that extends a third-party validation rule class, overriding error reporting to throw a custom ValidationException.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Overrides the base method to throw a custom ValidationException with the input and rule context.
